verdict.rationale: The IRS documents the Assurance Testing System (ATS), a dedicated test environment for Modernized e-File. It is explicitly distinguished from Production, with its own test scenarios, publications and separate SSL certificate bundles, so this is genuine environment isolation rather than a dry-run. However, access requires e-file provider enrollment and e-Services sign-in, and ATS opens only in dated seasonal windows, which limits on-demand testing for an AI-native user. Missing for 10: self-serve or on-demand sandbox access without enrollment gating, year-round availability, sandbox coverage beyond MeF (e.g. IRIS A2A or online account services), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: The IRS documents a dedicated test environment for its Modernized e-File system: the Assurance Testing System (ATS)

Transmitters, software developers, and state agencies are encouraged to review their implementations and complete any necessary changes in ATS prior to the Production deployment to avoid service disruptions.
